name: sessions
description: Session tokens stored as SHA-256 digests, secure cookies and CSRF tokens for HTTP services

api.name: Token
api.sig: pub type Token = {token: Str, digest: Str} derive Eq, Show
api.doc: A new session: `token` goes to the client, `digest` is what the server stores.

api.name: CookieOpts
api.sig: pub type CookieOpts = {name: Str where _.len > 0 and _.chars.all(c => c.is_alpha or c == "_" or c == "-"), path: Str, max_age: Int where _ >= 0, same_site: Str where _ == "Lax" or _ == "Strict", secure: Bool} derive Eq, Show
api.doc: How the session cookie is set. `secure` should be true whenever the site is served over HTTPS.

api.name: new_token
api.doc: A new random token and its digest.

api.name: digest
api.doc: The digest a server stores for `token`.

api.name: cookie_opts
api.sig: fn cookie_opts(name: Str, days: Int, secure: Bool) -> CookieOpts
api.doc: Secure defaults: HttpOnly always, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, and a lifetime of `days`.

api.name: set_cookie
api.sig: fn set_cookie(o: CookieOpts, value: Str) -> (Str, Str)
api.doc: The `set-cookie` header that gives the client `value`.

api.name: clear_cookie
api.doc: The `set-cookie` header that removes the cookie.

api.name: bearer
api.doc: The token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, if any.

api.name: csrf_token
api.sig: fn csrf_token(key: Secret[Str], binding: Str) -> Str
api.doc:
ANCHOR: csrf
The CSRF token for a form or request bound to `binding` (a session digest, or the value of an
anonymous cookie): an HMAC under the server's key, so it can't be forged or moved to another
session.

api.name: csrf_ok
api.sig: fn csrf_ok(key: Secret[Str], binding: Str, given: Str) -> Bool
api.doc: Whether `given` is the CSRF token for `binding`, compared in constant time.
